_comment: ETM variant-expansion companion, 2026-07-24: the 10 cases whose 'Data variations:' line did NOT need a genuine per-variant split (equivalence-class Adult/Child, a single mode note, an already-separately-covered product, or a leftover cross-reference) still get the banned label/text removed so no case reads as an unaddressed checklist. Plus 1 retirement (superseded duplicate). See etm-variant-expansion.changelog.md for the family-by-family rationale.

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm annulling the last issued ticket, the unconfirmed-annul timeout, and refusal where annulment is not permitted.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds: **GIVEN** a Driver on route 72b (IN) has just issued an Adult single ticket

steps.content: **WHEN** you annul the last issued ticket and confirm, then issue another and start an annul but let it time out unconfirmed
steps.expected:
**THEN** the confirmed annulment voids the last ticket and records it in CloudFare
**AND** the unconfirmed annul times out leaving that ticket valid

steps.content: **WHEN** you attempt to annul a ticket whose boarding stage has changed, or an MJ-validated, pass-validated or concession-pass transaction
steps.expected: **THEN** the annulment is refused with the reason shown

cases.expected:
The last ticket annuls; an unconfirmed annul times out leaving the ticket valid; annulment is refused with a reason for boarding-stage-changed, MJ-validated, pass-validated and concession-pass cases. Basket-transaction annulment is covered by its own case (Basket Mode — annul a basketed transaction).

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm a Driver can issue an Open (excess) ticket for a valid amount and that an invalid amount is rejected.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds: **GIVEN** a Driver is signed on to Ulsterbus route 72b (IN) at the FLU screen

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the Open Tickets flow, key a valid excess amount and issue
steps.expected:
**THEN** the Open excess ticket issues for the valid amount
**AND** the Open excess ticket prints for the valid amount

steps.content: **WHEN** you repeat, keying an invalid excess amount
steps.expected: **THEN** the invalid amount is rejected without issuing a ticket

cases.expected:
Open/excess tickets issue for a valid amount and reject invalid amounts.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm the ETM indicates when a promo product is not currently available and cannot be issued.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds:
**GIVEN** a promo product is configured as not currently available (e.g. Bus Rambler out of season)
**AND** a Driver is signed on to route 72b (IN) at the Promo Menu

steps.content: **WHEN** you select the unavailable promo product
steps.expected:
**THEN** the ETM flags the promo product as not available
**AND** the promo product cannot be issued

cases.expected:
An unavailable promo product is flagged not available and cannot be issued.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm smartcard validation and the passback rules for same versus different direction and within versus outside the transfer period.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds:
**GIVEN** a Driver is signed on to Metro route 10A at the FLU screen
**AND** a seeded valid smartcard product is available for the route

steps.content: **WHEN** you present the card to validate
steps.expected: **THEN** the first present validates with the success indication

steps.content: **WHEN** you re-present it inside the transfer period in the same direction, then again in the opposite direction, then again outside the transfer period
steps.expected:
**THEN** the same-direction re-present inside the period is handled as passback
**AND** the opposite-direction and outside-period re-presents follow the direction and transfer rules

cases.expected:
A valid card validates with passback within the transfer period; direction and outside-transfer rules apply. Metro and Ulsterbus Multi-Journey zone/boarding-stage specifics are covered by their own dedicated cases.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm a successful smartcard top-up with auto-validation, the maximum-journey cap, and removal of expired journeys.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds: **GIVEN** a customer presents a topp-able smartcard and the Driver selects Top-Up on route 72b (IN)

steps.content: **WHEN** you top up the card and take payment
steps.expected:
**THEN** the top-up succeeds with a receipt
**AND** the card auto-validates

steps.content: **WHEN** you top up a Multi-Journey card at its journey limit
steps.expected: **THEN** the Multi-Journey balance caps at 50 journeys

steps.content: **WHEN** you top up a card carrying expired journeys, then check the receipt and open the CloudFare activity log
steps.expected: **THEN** the expired journeys are removed on top-up

cases.expected:
Top-up succeeds (receipt plus auto-validate); MJ caps at 50 journeys; expired journeys are removed on top-up (DayLink / iLink / Travelcard periods); recorded in CloudFare, MERIT and SmartTrack.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm a smartcard top-up can be annulled and recorded.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds: **GIVEN** a Driver on route 72b (IN) has just topped up a smartcard

steps.content: **WHEN** you annul the top-up and confirm
steps.expected: **THEN** the top-up is annulled on the ETM

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the CloudFare activity log
steps.expected:
**THEN** the annulment is recorded in the CloudFare activity log
**AND** the annulment flows to MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.expected:
A smartcard top-up can be annulled and is recorded in CloudFare, MERIT and SmartTrack.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm an Ulsterbus Multi-Journey card validates with a valid boarding stage and rejects an invalid one.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds:
**GIVEN** a Driver is signed on to Ulsterbus route 72b (IN) in Ulsterbus mode
**AND** an Ulsterbus Multi-Journey card is presented

steps.content: **WHEN** you present the card with a valid boarding stage set
steps.expected:
**THEN** the valid-boarding-stage present validates
**AND** a journey is deducted

steps.content: **WHEN** you present the card with an invalid boarding stage
steps.expected: **THEN** the invalid-boarding-stage present is rejected with the reason

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the CloudFare activity log
steps.expected:
**THEN** both presents are recorded in the CloudFare activity log
**AND** both presents flow to MERIT and SmartTrack

cases.expected:
Ulsterbus MJ validates on a valid boarding stage and rejects an invalid one; recorded in CloudFare, MERIT and SmartTrack.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm ABT boarding within a Metro ABT zone (Tap On Only – Flat Fare); the customer taps once to board and the ETM calculates the alighting stop — there is no customer alighting tap on this device.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds:
**GIVEN** ABT is enabled in a Metro ABT zone (route ABT Type = "Tap On Only (Flat Fare)") and a Driver is signed on to Metro route 10A
**AND** a seeded contactless card is available

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer taps once for boarding on the current Metro route
steps.expected:
**THEN** the Metro ABT zone records the boarding tap
**AND** the alighting stop is ETM-calculated as the last stop on the route within the configured Metro Network Zone (no customer alighting tap)

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the CloudFare activity log
steps.expected:
**THEN** the tap is recorded with the boarding stop
**AND** it is recorded with the ETM-calculated alighting stop

cases.expected:
The Metro ABT zone records boarding-only, alighting-only and both; recorded in CloudFare and MERIT.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm ABT boarding and driver-selected alighting within Ulsterbus ABT zones (Tap On Only – Driver Initiated); the customer taps once to board and states their alighting stage, and the Driver selects it on the FLU screen — there is no customer alighting tap on this device.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds:
**GIVEN** ABT is enabled in an Ulsterbus ABT zone (route ABT Type = "Tap On Only (Driver Initiated)") and a Driver is signed on to Ulsterbus route 72b (IN)
**AND** a seeded contactless card is available

steps.content: **WHEN** the customer taps once for boarding, states their alighting stage, and the Driver selects that alighting stage on the FLU screen
steps.expected:
**THEN** the Ulsterbus ABT zone records the boarding tap
**AND** it records the driver-selected alighting stage (not ETM-calculated)

steps.content: **WHEN** you open the CloudFare activity log
steps.expected:
**THEN** the tap is recorded with the boarding stop
**AND** it is recorded with the driver-selected alighting stage

cases.expected:
The Ulsterbus ABT zone records boarding-only, alighting-only and both; recorded in CloudFare and MERIT.

[Automatable: Partial · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT]

cases.preface:
This test is to confirm the ETM validates the supported MIFARE card types.

Design reference (Overflow): https://overflow.io/s/NDLGF6NF/
cases.preconds:
**GIVEN** the seeded test Driver is signed on to route 10A (IN)
**AND** a MIFARE Classic 1K card and a MIFARE Classic EV1 card are to hand

steps.content: **WHEN** you present the MIFARE Classic 1K card, then the MIFARE Classic EV1 card
steps.expected:
**THEN** the ETM reads and validates each card per its type
**AND** the validation is recorded in the back office (CloudFare, MERIT and SmartTrack)

cases.expected:
The ETM validates the supported MIFARE card types (Classic 1K, Classic EV1) against their 8-digit PSN range, and the validations are recorded in the back office.

[Automatable: No · Cross-check: CloudFare / MERIT / SmartTrack]
